topic: What interference mitigation techniques are viable for overlapping service transmissions across geographically dispersed ground stations?
consensus_response: Viable techniques include beamforming, rate splitting, and adaptive frequency allocation. Beamforming spatially separates signals, while rate splitting reduces co-channel interference. Adaptive frequency allocation dynamically assigns spectrum, minimizing interference. Machine learning optimizes these techniques by predicting channel conditions and automating adjustments.
reference_context: SatCom and RF engineering studies provide insights into interference mitigation, including polarization correlation coefficients and spectral efficiency enhancements.
